name: Good Help Is Hard to Find
source:
You are a diligent maid in the employ of Miss Carmilla. One night, she gives you a job to do - clean up after a rather messy dinner. How far will you go to complete your task?

[From [url=https://redmoonrisingdev.itch.io/good-help-is-hard-to-find]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是卡米拉小姐雇用的一位勤奋的女仆。一天晚上，她给了你一项工作——在一顿相当混乱的晚餐后清理。你会走多远来完成你的任务？

[来自[url=https://redmoonrisingdev.itch.io/good-help-is-hard-to-find]Itch.io[/url]]
